query: SELECT f.id,f.layer,f.geometry,f.properties FROM features f JOIN bounds b ON f.id=b.id WHERE f.minzoom<=? AND b.minx<=? AND b.maxx>=? AND b.miny<=? AND b.maxy>=?
plan: SEARCH f USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
interpretation: Spatial Rtree bounds index first, then primary-key feature lookup; no full feature scan per tile.
